subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Which branch should become the sole canonical implementation for the Google Chat app-auth media fallback?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 overlap the same three runtime paths but use materially different authorization predicates and result handling; automation cannot safely select the permanent branch owner while neither candidate is fully land-ready.

options.title: Refresh the narrower candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 as the canonical branch, refresh it onto current main, preserve current result contracts, and require live proof.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR canonical only after narrowing its predicate, preserving action metadata, resolving base drift, and adding inspectable live proof.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Leave the canonical issue open without landing either fallback if the broader user-OAuth direction should own media delivery behavior.

recommendation.title: Refresh the narrower candidate
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 as the canonical branch, refresh it onto current main, preserve current result contracts, and require live proof.
